bull.b: Clinical validation of Axiomer supports the platform’s biological mechanism and improves credibility with partners. Sustained target engagement and favorable early safety provide a stronger foundation for advancing AX-0811 and broader RNA-editing programs.

A larger cash balance and runway into mid-2028 give ProQR time to generate clinical data without immediate financing pressure. This supports continued investment in multiple programs and improves negotiating flexibility with potential partners.

bull.t: Revenue growth and high gross margins
bull.b: Strong revenue growth and very high gross margins indicate that collaboration-related income can scale efficiently when programs generate payments. These trends provide operating leverage potential if partnerships and development milestones expand.

bear.b: Large recurring losses and negative operating cash flow show that ProQR cannot currently fund research and development from operations. Continued burn may erode equity and require additional financing before products or royalties become commercial.

The equity financing reinforces dependence on external capital to fund development. Repeated share issuance can dilute existing holders and may become more costly or constrained if clinical progress, partnerships, or market access disappoint.

Without approved products or recurring commercial sales, revenue remains dependent on collaborations, grants and milestone payments. This creates uneven visibility and leaves long-term funding capacity exposed to partner decisions and clinical outcomes.
